scan.exclusion_rule: Reject both sides of a pair if a Cargo build/test is detected at 500ms intervals. Require a 5s quiet window before each pair.

install.fixture_source: Integrity-verified local archives from top-1000.json; no registry download during timed installs.

controls.cold_definition: Empty package store and project state; operating-system file cache is warm.
controls.warm_definition: Reuse the package store, remove project dependency state, and install again.
controls.up_to_date_definition: Run install again without removing project state.

install.exclusion_rule: Reject the entire install run if Cargo build/test activity is detected at 500 ms intervals. Require a 5 s quiet window before each run.

protocol.reason: Seven-pair source-disabled cold-install timing comparison was inconclusive.
protocol.cells: All original modes and enabled/disabled settings
protocol.selection: Retain all seven original pairs and all twenty new pairs; report both runs and pooled distributions.

install.interpretation: Every install completed successfully. The initial comparison was inconclusive. The fixed 20-pair extension reports a cold-install timing regression with source analysis enabled; all other cells pass. This cost is retained as a correctness trade-off.

limitations: Single-machine measurement; background desktop activity and filesystem cache are not fully controlled.
The install fixture has five local archives and does not estimate network-heavy project installs.
Peak RSS is the operating-system measurement of each whole scanner or installer process.
The source scan uses four Rayon threads and scans packages sequentially.
